route_modules.label: Universal database obligations
route_modules.description: Checks required for every database regardless of discipline, modality, storage form, or access regime.

facets.requirement: Resolve canonical source identity, aliases, responsible institutions, and database boundary.
facets.completion_evidence: Official identity and institutional evidence with canonical GRDR references.

facets.requirement: Separate original production, collection, harmonization, derivation, publication, mirroring, and maintenance roles.
facets.completion_evidence: Evidence-backed provenance chain with unresolved roles explicitly recorded.

facets.requirement: Define a reproducible dated, versioned, partitioned, question-bounded, or rolling universe and denominator strategy.
facets.completion_evidence: Boundary statement, enumeration rule, dated evidence, and known denominator or explicit non-enumerable limitation.

facets.requirement: Identify snapshot, release, revision, append, rolling, deletion, and schema-change behavior.
facets.completion_evidence: Official version/change documentation or repeated probes with a refresh policy.

facets.requirement: Record licenses, terms, citation, attribution, privacy, ethics, sovereignty, retention, and redistribution controls.
facets.completion_evidence: Current authoritative policy evidence and any required human authorization gate.

facets.requirement: Resolve unit identity, producer, population or universe, observation unit, method, coverage, release, limitations, and citation.
facets.completion_evidence: Official dataset metadata, method documentation, and canonical Dataset record.

facets.requirement: Record missingness, suppression, imputation, uncertainty, calibration, revisions, bias, and comparability limits where applicable.
facets.completion_evidence: Quality or methodology evidence and explicit unknown/not-applicable decisions.

facets.requirement: Recover the source-native organization without substituting an access URL for structure.
facets.completion_evidence: Versioned schema, codebook, manifest, instrument, graph, array, stream, or observed structure.

facets.requirement: Enumerate native fields, dimensions, measures, identifiers, attributes, flags, items, coordinates, or annotations within the declared boundary.
facets.completion_evidence: Reproducible count, ordering or manifest, and canonical DataElement coverage.

facets.requirement: Define research-matchable operational quantities without inferring them from topic labels.
facets.completion_evidence: Official definitions plus structural selections, units, population, resolution, and comparability.

facets.requirement: Link variables to constructs while distinguishing direct, subjective, administrative, constructed, modelled, forecast, proxy, and latent measures.
facets.completion_evidence: Evidence-backed mappings with directness and scope limitations.

facets.requirement: Document entity identifiers, time keys, spatial keys, version keys, linkage assumptions, collision risks, and identity resolution.
facets.completion_evidence: Key definitions and a tested or explicitly limited joinability assessment.

facets.requirement: Test metadata and observation access separately and record authentication, limits, formats, environment, query, and reproducibility conditions.
facets.completion_evidence: Dated access probes or evidenced controlled-access procedure covering every required route.

facets.requirement: Lock the audited plan, declared scope, and ordered work-unit manifest so an Agent cannot silently change the target, denominator, routes, or completion claim.
facets.completion_evidence: Machine-recomputed SHA-256 fingerprints for the plan, scope, and unit manifest match the persisted execution locks.

facets.requirement: Persist deterministic checkpoints and resume the first unfinished target without skipping, substitution, or loss after process, network, or session interruption.
facets.completion_evidence: Replay tests and current project history reproduce the same next target and validate every checkpoint checksum.

facets.requirement: Recover the complete source-native structural graph from Dataset through recursive DataStructure nodes and DataElements to operational Variables, including grain, keys, ordering, cardinality, lineage, roots, leaves, and edges.
facets.completion_evidence: A bounded, counted, connected, fingerprinted canonical structural spine whose nodes and relationships are all verified or explicitly evidenced not applicable.

facets.requirement: Recover the multi-parent scientific-semantic graph from disciplines and subdisciplines through research objects, systems, phenomena, processes, populations and units to Constructs without reducing it to topic strings.
facets.completion_evidence: A bounded, counted, connected, fingerprinted semantic spine using canonical SemanticNode and Construct records with source-native and external classification mappings preserved.

facets.requirement: Prove the canonical bridge connecting source-native DataElements and DataStructures to research-matchable Variables and evidenced Constructs or scientific-semantic nodes.
facets.completion_evidence: Every bridge node and relationship is counted, verified, fingerprinted, and exposes measurement directness, units, population, resolution, comparability, and join conditions.

route_modules.label: Catalog and repository hierarchy
route_modules.description: Catalogs, repositories, portals, collections, versions, and distributions.

facets.requirement: Preserve catalog, collection, dataset, version, and distribution hierarchy.
facets.completion_evidence: Complete bounded catalog traversal with stable native identifiers.

facets.requirement: Separate datasets from their files, APIs, landing pages, mirrors, and distributions.
facets.completion_evidence: Every distribution linked as an access Resource with format and rights.

route_modules.label: File and object archive
route_modules.description: Static or versioned directories, object stores, packages, compressed archives, and large file manifests.

facets.requirement: Enumerate path, object identity, version, size, media type, packaging, checksum, and nesting.
facets.completion_evidence: Stable manifest or deterministic listing with counts and checksums where available.

facets.requirement: Test lawful extraction and decoding for every distinct required format, including compression and encryption boundaries.
facets.completion_evidence: Format-specific probe results and required software or keys without exposing secrets.

route_modules.label: Tabular and relational schema
route_modules.description: Relational databases, tables, views, CSV/Parquet collections, and data packages.

facets.requirement: Recover schemas, tables, views, columns, types, nullability, constraints, primary/foreign keys, and row grain.
facets.completion_evidence: Machine schema or reproducible introspection covering the bounded table universe.

facets.requirement: Distinguish stored, computed, denormalized, coded, and externally joined fields.
facets.completion_evidence: Field lineage, calculation logic, code lists, and canonical variable mapping.

route_modules.label: Web API and query service
route_modules.description: REST, GraphQL, SOAP, JSON/XML, OData, search, and query APIs.

facets.requirement: Enumerate endpoints, operations, request/response schemas, parameters, pagination, filters, and error semantics.
facets.completion_evidence: Official machine schema or dated endpoint inventory with representative successful and failing probes.

facets.requirement: Record authentication, scopes, quotas, rate limits, pagination caps, timeouts, retries, and nondeterminism.
facets.completion_evidence: Documentation plus bounded live probes that do not bypass controls.

route_modules.label: SDMX or statistical cube
route_modules.description: Multidimensional official-statistics dataflows and cube systems.

facets.requirement: Resolve measure, ordered dimensions, time dimension, codelists, attributes, units, multipliers, flags, and attachment levels.
facets.completion_evidence: Versioned DSD/schema and complete referenced code-list inventory.

facets.requirement: Define each variable by measure plus all meaning-bearing dimension selections.
facets.completion_evidence: Complete declared variable universe linked to native dimension codes.

facets.requirement: Test structure metadata and observation retrieval independently.
facets.completion_evidence: Dated probes recording query keys, response status, units, flags, and failures.

route_modules.label: Survey, study, questionnaire, and microdata
route_modules.description: Studies, waves, samples, instruments, questions, response codes, weights, and derived scales.

facets.requirement: Record universe, sampling frame, design, strata, clusters, weights, modes, nonresponse, waves, and fieldwork.
facets.completion_evidence: Questionnaire, methods, sampling, and weight documentation.

facets.requirement: Preserve instrument, section, question wording, routing, response codes, missing codes, and derived-variable lineage.
facets.completion_evidence: Complete bounded questionnaire/codebook mapping in native order.

route_modules.label: Administrative, transactional, and event systems
route_modules.description: Operational records generated by services, organizations, firms, and public administration.

facets.requirement: Recover eligibility, service or transaction process, capture incentives, coding changes, revisions, and coverage exclusions.
facets.completion_evidence: Operational manuals, data dictionaries, and provenance evidence.

facets.requirement: Resolve entity, event, episode, status, effective-time, record-time, and linkage semantics.
facets.completion_evidence: Schema and identity/change documentation with tested temporal grain.

route_modules.label: Geospatial vector, raster, tile, and coverage
route_modules.description: Spatial layers, rasters, grids, tiles, coverages, and coordinate-aware observations.

facets.requirement: Record CRS, datum, axis order, extent, geometry or grid, resolution, tiling, bands, nodata, masks, and topology.
facets.completion_evidence: Machine-readable layer/coverage metadata and spatial bounds.

facets.requirement: Record sensor/source lineage, positional accuracy, resampling, classification, cloud/quality masks, and processing level.
facets.completion_evidence: Product specification plus representative metadata or quality-band inspection.

route_modules.label: Scientific arrays and multidimensional files
route_modules.description: NetCDF, HDF, Zarr, GRIB, FITS, and other dimensioned scientific data.

facets.requirement: Recover files/stores, groups, dimensions, coordinates, chunks, compression, fill values, and encoding.
facets.completion_evidence: Machine metadata from every bounded structure/version.

facets.requirement: Record units, standard names, coordinate conventions, calibration, uncertainty, and quality-control variables.
facets.completion_evidence: Convention metadata and variable/coordinate inventory.

route_modules.label: Sensor, telemetry, and streaming events
route_modules.description: Live or append-only observations whose universe grows or expires.

facets.requirement: Resolve event schema, key, partition, event/ingest time, ordering, lateness, duplication, retention, replay, and schema evolution.
facets.completion_evidence: Versioned event contract and bounded stream-window definition.

facets.requirement: Use a rolling window, offset range, or archived segment; never claim a live stream is globally exhausted.
facets.completion_evidence: Start/end offsets or times, watermark policy, and replayable manifest.

route_modules.label: Biomedical, genomic, proteomic, assay, and molecular structure
route_modules.description: Studies, participants, specimens, assays, sequences, features, ontologies, and reference builds.

facets.requirement: Preserve study, subject, biospecimen, assay, run, feature, reference build, ontology, batch, and processing pipeline.
facets.completion_evidence: Accessioned native hierarchy and assay/sequence metadata.

facets.requirement: Record consent codes, controlled tiers, genomic privacy, secondary-use limits, and sample/data linkage.
facets.completion_evidence: Authoritative access and consent evidence plus required human authorization.

route_modules.label: Clinical and health-record interoperability
route_modules.description: Patients, encounters, observations, diagnoses, procedures, medications, claims, cohorts, and common data models.

facets.requirement: Resolve patient/event grain, resource/table profiles, terminologies, value sets, temporal semantics, and cohort inclusion.
facets.completion_evidence: Implementation guide or common-data-model version plus terminology bindings.

facets.requirement: Preserve consent, minimum necessary access, deidentification, IRB/ethics, audit, and output controls.
facets.completion_evidence: Approved governance path; no observation retrieval without authorization.

route_modules.label: Knowledge graph and linked data
route_modules.description: RDF/property graphs, ontologies, entity networks, SPARQL, graph dumps, and evolving identifiers.

facets.requirement: Enumerate classes, properties, edge types, constraints, named graphs, provenance, and common query patterns.
facets.completion_evidence: Ontology/schema versions, statistics, and bounded graph snapshot or endpoint inventory.

facets.requirement: Resolve identifier namespaces, same-as semantics, redirects, inferred edges, confidence, and temporal validity.
facets.completion_evidence: Identity and inference documentation with representative edge provenance.

route_modules.label: Text, document, image, audio, and video corpus
route_modules.description: Items, segments, transcriptions, OCR, annotations, labels, media, and rights.

facets.requirement: Recover corpus, item, version, segment, transcript/OCR, language, annotation, and label hierarchy.
facets.completion_evidence: Manifest/schema and annotation protocol covering the bounded corpus.

facets.requirement: Record item-level rights, takedowns, provenance, sampling/collection bias, representation, and annotation reliability.
facets.completion_evidence: Rights and methodology evidence with known exclusions and bias limits.

route_modules.label: Laboratory and field experiment
route_modules.description: Experiments, protocols, treatments, controls, experimental units, samples, randomization, repeated measurements, and processed outputs.

facets.requirement: Recover hypotheses or objectives, design, protocol version, treatments, controls, randomization, blinding, replication, sampling, and deviations.
facets.completion_evidence: Protocol/design evidence links every experimental unit and outcome to the applicable conditions and deviations.

facets.requirement: Separate experimental-unit, sample, treatment, measurement, replicate, outcome, and processing identities and preserve their one-to-many lineage.
facets.completion_evidence: Native unit/sample/measurement hierarchy is enumerated without conflating treatment assignment, raw observations, and processed outcomes.

route_modules.label: Instrument acquisition, calibration, and measurement run
route_modules.description: Passive or active instrument measurements, devices, deployments, acquisition runs, firmware, calibration, detection limits, and processing levels.

facets.requirement: Separate platform, device, deployment, acquisition run, channel, sample, processing level, and output identity with acquisition settings and time bases.
facets.completion_evidence: A stable device/deployment/run topology and raw-to-processed lineage are enumerated for the declared boundary.

facets.requirement: Record device and firmware version, calibration method and validity period, reference standard, detection and saturation limits, resolution, drift, uncertainty, and quality controls.
facets.completion_evidence: Operational measurements retain applicable calibration, quality, and uncertainty evidence without implying an experimental treatment design.

route_modules.label: Simulation, scenario, ensemble, and computational model output
route_modules.description: Model experiments, scenarios, ensembles, initial conditions, parameterizations, forcing data, runs, checkpoints, and outputs.

facets.requirement: Identify model and code version, experiment, scenario, ensemble member, run, initialization, parameters, forcing inputs, grid, timestep, and output variables.
facets.completion_evidence: A reproducible run key and configuration-to-output lineage are recovered for the declared boundary.

facets.requirement: Distinguish simulated, assimilated, calibrated, hindcast, forecast, counterfactual, and observed quantities and record validation and uncertainty limits.
facets.completion_evidence: Construct mappings expose model status, scenario assumptions, evaluation evidence, ensemble semantics, and applicable inference limits.

route_modules.label: Physical specimen, object, and natural or cultural collection
route_modules.description: Physical specimens or objects, accessions, collection events, custody, preparation, identification, digitization, and derived measurements.

facets.requirement: Separate object/specimen, accession, lot, sample, subsample, collection event, location, custodian, identifier history, preparation, and digitization.
facets.completion_evidence: Stable identifiers and custody/derivation links preserve the physical-to-digital chain and one-to-many relationships.

facets.requirement: Record identification or classification method, determiner, taxonomy or controlled vocabulary version, uncertainty, georeferencing, and later redeterminations.
facets.completion_evidence: Operational variables retain the versioned identification context and do not treat changing labels as immutable facts.

route_modules.label: Qualitative, ethnographic, interview, and case-study archive
route_modules.description: Cases, participants, interviews, fieldnotes, transcripts, documents, coding frameworks, analytic memos, consent, and contextual metadata.

facets.requirement: Preserve case, participant, event, session, document, segment, speaker, chronology, field context, translation, and anonymization relationships.
facets.completion_evidence: Native case and document topology is recovered with contextual loss and de-identification transformations explicit.

facets.requirement: Separate source text, source-authored classifications, researcher codes, categories, themes, memos, and theoretical constructs with coder and version provenance.
facets.completion_evidence: Every promoted construct is traceable to citable source segments or documented source coding; AI inference remains labelled and reviewable.

route_modules.label: Scholarly works, citations, grants, patents, and research entities
route_modules.description: Works and versions, authors, organizations, venues, references, citations, grants, patents, research objects, corrections, and retractions.

facets.requirement: Resolve work versus manifestation or version, persistent and provider identifiers, authorship, venue, dates, references, corrections, retractions, grants, and patents without double counting.
facets.completion_evidence: Entity-resolution rules and version relationships are tested against duplicates, mergers, splits, and identifier changes.

facets.requirement: Record source coverage, field/language/geography/time bias, citation window, document type, author disambiguation, fractionalization, and indicator construction.
facets.completion_evidence: Each research variable states its counting universe, time window, normalization, coverage limits, and identity-resolution assumptions.

route_modules.label: Web, app, social platform, and digital behavioral trace
route_modules.description: Mutable platform objects, accounts, interactions, feeds, rankings, logs, crawls, deletions, moderation, and platform-mediated exposure.

facets.requirement: Record collection surface, query or crawl design, ranking or recommendation mediation, account state, sampling, rate limits, deletions, moderation, and platform policy/version.
facets.completion_evidence: The obtainable universe and exposure mechanism are distinguished from the platform population with dated collection provenance.

facets.requirement: Separate accounts, actors, platform objects, content versions, events, interactions, impressions, edges, and deletion/tombstone states.
facets.completion_evidence: Identifiers, event time versus collection time, mutation, deletion, and cross-snapshot reconciliation are explicit.

route_modules.label: Machine-learning dataset, model, embedding, and synthetic data
route_modules.description: Training/evaluation datasets, models, features, embeddings, generated data, and benchmarks.

facets.requirement: Trace training/evaluation inputs, preprocessing, versions, splits, leakage controls, model/generator, randomness, and licenses.
facets.completion_evidence: Data/model cards and reproducible lineage to upstream assets.

facets.requirement: Distinguish source features, learned representations, labels, predictions, scores, synthetic fields, and evaluation metrics.
facets.completion_evidence: Schema and documented construction/validation for each operational output.

route_modules.label: Executable workflow and research compendium
route_modules.description: Code, notebooks, workflow graphs, environments, software-generated datasets, and reproducibility packages.

facets.requirement: Record workflow steps, code version, parameters, inputs, outputs, environment, dependencies, containers, and randomness.
facets.completion_evidence: Versioned workflow graph and executable or inspectable environment definition.

facets.requirement: Separate documented reproducibility from successful re-execution and preserve legal/compute limits.
facets.completion_evidence: Bounded execution or dry-run log, checksums, and unresolved environment constraints.

route_modules.label: Restricted, licensed, secure, or application access
route_modules.description: Data that require registration, payment, contracts, ethics review, secure environments, or disclosure control.

facets.requirement: Separate public metadata work from operations requiring user identity, agreement, payment, ethics approval, or institutional authority.
facets.completion_evidence: Named human authorization and exact approved scope before protected access.

facets.requirement: Record secure environment, linkage, retention, export, disclosure review, citation, and destruction rules.
facets.completion_evidence: Authoritative governance documents and an approved access path; metadata-only mapping remains explicitly limited.

route_modules.label: Derived, harmonized, modelled, or mirrored data
route_modules.description: Secondary products whose authority, meaning, and quality depend on upstream versions and transformations.

facets.requirement: Identify original producers, exact upstream datasets/versions, acquisition dates, transformations, harmonization, models, and revision propagation.
facets.completion_evidence: Evidence-backed lineage that does not assign aggregator claims to producers or vice versa.

facets.requirement: Record definition crosswalks, unit conversions, rebasing, imputations, model assumptions, breaks, and non-equivalence.
facets.completion_evidence: Transformation/method evidence and variable-level comparability status.

route_modules.label: Federated and linked multi-source system
route_modules.description: Virtual databases, cross-source query layers, identity resolution systems, and distributed collections.

facets.requirement: Enumerate participating sources, ownership, endpoint versions, query delegation, caching, and partial-failure semantics.
facets.completion_evidence: Dated federation manifest or reproducible membership discovery.

facets.requirement: Record identifier crosswalks, linkage algorithms, confidence, collisions, update behavior, and non-joins.
facets.completion_evidence: Tested identity-resolution rules and provenance-preserving links.

route_modules.label: Legacy, undocumented, or proprietary format
route_modules.description: Formats or systems requiring vendor software, reverse engineering, conversion, emulation, or incomplete metadata.

facets.requirement: Preserve original bytes, format/version evidence, decoding software, conversion parameters, loss, and uncertainty.
facets.completion_evidence: Reproducible lawful decode or explicit blocked state with original-format checksum.

facets.requirement: Separate observed structure from inferred schema and require evidence before semantic promotion.
facets.completion_evidence: Field-level observed/inferred status and human review for ambiguous semantics.

route_modules.label: Unknown or custom database route
route_modules.description: Safe fallback when existing contracts do not fully explain a structure, modality, lifecycle, or governance model.

facets.requirement: Document unexplained signals, observed invariants, candidate work-unit boundary, safe probes, and why existing routes are insufficient.
facets.completion_evidence: Evidence-backed custom route proposal reviewed before any completion claim.

facets.requirement: Decide whether to compose existing routes, add a new route contract, or remain blocked without forcing a false classification.
facets.completion_evidence: Audited extension decision and new tests when a reusable route is added.
